name: Khoru
instructions: 1. Whisk the yogurt and gram flour together in a bowl until smooth and free of lumps.
2. Add water to the mixture to reach a thin, pouring consistency.
3. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan until it reaches a smoking point.
4. Add mustard seeds (or Jakhia) and dry red chillies to the hot oil.
5. Once the seeds crackle, pour the yogurt mixture into the pan.
6. Add turmeric powder and salt, then cook on low flame, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
7. Allow the mixture to simmer for about 10-15 minutes until thickened slightly.
8. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Khoru is a quintessential comfort food from Himachal Pradesh. It is a light, tangy, and cooling curd-based dish prepared frequently in Himachali households. It is culturally significant for its simplicity and is a staple during daily meals, often enjoyed alongside local red rice or other traditional Himachali side dishes.
